how: Crowdsourced blind battles: a visitor sends one prompt to two anonymous models, votes for the better answer, and votes update a Bradley-Terry rating. Scores change continuously on the live leaderboard.
name: LMArena (Chatbot Arena)
note: The chat and general LLM comparison on srjconsultingservices.com is built on this rating system; consult the live leaderboard for current standings, which move weekly.
measures: Human preference: which model people prefer in blind head-to-head conversations, aggregated into Elo-style ratings across categories including coding, math, and creative writing.
not_measured: Factual correctness directly, and it can reward style, confidence, and formatting; rankings shift as the voter population and prompts shift.
